title: Driller's Console
subtitle: A drilling rig's control panel, in your browser

card: I built a free simulator to show it.
scenes.text: A training simulator of a drilling rig's control panel, running in the browser.
Everything the driller watches, on one screen: depth, weight on bit, drilling speed, pump pressure.
scenes.note: Every value is linked: change one and the others respond.

scenes.text: The driller raises the weight on the bit. The bit drills faster, and torque and pressure follow.
scenes.note: WOB = weight on bit · ROP = rate of penetration

scenes.text: Mud is pumped down the drill pipe, out through the bit, and back up carrying the rock cuttings.
scenes.note: The panel checks whether the hole is being cleaned.

scenes.text: The PDC bit turns at the real RPM, and its cutters wear as it drills.
The instructor triggers a kick: gas flows into the well, the mud pits gain volume and the alarms go off.
scenes.note: Kick = unwanted flow of formation fluid into the well

scenes.text: The driller stops the pumps and closes the BOP. The kill sheet fills in: shut-in pressures and kill mud weight.
Every event is logged on real-time trends and in the alarm list, as on a real rig.
Built for students and new drilling engineers.
scenes.note: A simplified training model, not calibrated to a real rig.
